propositions: A Pass-2 finding during execution-phase review can be a false positive when the plan's directed work is already completed and the current code state satisfies the plan's goal.
A new na-default binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` enables the verifier to assert whether present code state already meets the plan's end state.

Pass-2 drops findings with `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal="yes"` during execution reviews (veto reason: `plan-goal-satisfied`) only when the finding's criteria belong to the `CODEBASE_GROUNDED` cohort.
The `execution_review` kwarg flows from orchestrator into `pass3_decide` to gate the veto, defaulting False so planning reviews and code-review calls are unaffected.

Cohort restriction is enforced deterministically in the orchestrator wrapper (`_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded`), forcing non-grounded findings to `na` before kernel delegation to prevent tool-less verification from firing the veto.
